about: Consent rules the TypeScript control grant and the input helper must agree on. Each case runs against the grant book (packages/screen/src/consent-rules.test.ts) and the helper stand-in (packages/desktop/src/main/screen/helper/stand-in.test.ts); the Rust helper reads the same file.

cases.name: input without a grant is refused
input under a live control grant is applied
input after the grant expires is refused
a grant never survives a restart
